stem: One way that Whaley and Wignall are alike is that —

options.label: A
options.text: they both want to attend college and earn teaching degrees

options.label: B
options.text: they have both received awards for their willingness to assist others

options.label: C
options.text: their concern for other people has inspired both of them to think creatively

options.label: D
options.text: their enjoyment of volunteering has motivated them to start their own organizations
